definitions.gloss: to be irritated; to be frustrated; to be on edge
definitions.explanation: to feel annoyed or impatient, often expressed outwardly

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{苛立|いらだ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm irritated by the traffic jam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{苛立|いらだ}った⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: He hung up the phone in an irritated manner.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}たされて⟦{苛立|いらだ}ち→苛立ち：05815_iradachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt frustrated from being kept waiting.

notes:
{苛立|いらだ}つ expresses a feeling of irritation or frustration.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (つ-verb)
- Intransitive

WRITING:
- {苛|いら} means "harsh, cruel" but here expresses irritation
- Often written in hiragana: いらだつ, いら{立|だ}つ

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苛立|いらだ}った⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (irritated voice)
- {苛立|いらだ}った⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧ (irritated manner)
- ⟦{苛立|いらだ}ち→苛立ち：05815_iradachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel irritation)
- ⟦{苛立|いらだ}ち→苛立ち：05815_iradachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}せない→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (unable to hide irritation)

FORMS:
- ⟦{苛立|いらだ}ち→苛立ち：05815_iradachi⟧ (noun: irritation, frustration)
- ⟦{苛立|いらだ}たしい→苛立たしい：29044_iradatashii⟧ (adjective: irritating)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- イライラ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be irritated - onomatopoeia, more casual)
- ⟦{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ→腹が立つ：06886_haragatatsu⟧ (to get angry - stronger)
- ⟦じれったい→じれったい：22590_jirettai⟧ (frustrating - focus on impatience)
- ⟦{焦|あせ}る→焦る：04619_aseru⟧ (to be impatient)

USAGE:
- Stronger than simple annoyance
- Often visible in behavior or tone
- Can be caused by waiting, inconvenience, or frustrating situations

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
